change_record.title: Database Schema Definition API now supports creation of generated columns

description.excerpt: The DB Schema Definition added support for generated columns, which can then be part of indexes just like regular ones. References: MySql: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/9.7/en/create-table-generated-columns.html MariaDb: https://mariadb.com/docs/server/reference/sql-statements/data-definition... PostgreSql: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/ddl-generated-columns.html SQLite: https://sqlite.org/gencol.html Column::generated() adds the definition of a generated table column. Drupal\Core\Database\SchemaDefinition\GeneratedColumnStorage enumerates the possible storage options for the gene

symbols.semantics: A change record names symbols. It does not, in this contract, assert their lifecycle; that comes from the deprecation index.
